project.description: Pull the bdc-ingest-only bucket and stage it in raw data

hudson.tasks.Shell.command:
#!/usr/bin/env bash set -euo pipefail
fail() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2 exit 1 }
BDC_INGESTION_ONLY_PREFIX="BDC-ingestion-only" nhlbi_account_number="714862078411"
[[ -n "${buckets:-}" ]] || fail "buckets parameter is required" [[ -n "${study_abv_name:-}" ]] || fail "study_abv_name parameter is required"
study_abv_name_lower="${study_abv_name,,}" target_s3_uri="s3://avillach-73-bdcatalyst-etl/${study_abv_name_lower}/rawData/"
mapfile -t bucket_array <<< "${buckets}"
for bucket in "${bucket_array[@]}"; do bucket="$(echo "${bucket}" | xargs)"
if [[ -z "${bucket}" ]]; then continue fi
if [[ ! "${bucket}" =~ ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]{1,61}[a-z0-9]$ ]]; then fail "Invalid S3 bucket name: ${bucket}" fi
echo "Processing bucket: ${bucket}"
rm -rf ./stage mkdir -p ./stage
aws sts assume-role \ --role-arn "arn:aws:iam::${nhlbi_account_number}:role/nih-nhlbi-TopMed-EC2Access-S3" \ --role-session-name "get-phenotypic-data" \ > assume-role-output.json \ || fail "Failed to assume NHLBI source role"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID export AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY export AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' assume-role-output.json)" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' assume-role-output.json)" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' assume-role-output.json)"
[[ -n "${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}" && "${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}" != "null" ]] || fail "Missing source AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" [[ -n "${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}" && "${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}" != "null" ]] || fail "Missing source AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" [[ -n "${AWS_SESSION_TOKEN}" && "${AWS_SESSION_TOKEN}" != "null" ]] || fail "Missing source AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"
aws s3 cp "s3://${bucket}/${BDC_INGESTION_ONLY_PREFIX}/" ./stage/ \ --recursive \ --no-progress \ || fail "Failed to copy from s3://${bucket}/${BDC_INGESTION_ONLY_PREFIX}/"
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
aws sts assume-role \ --duration-seconds 900 \ --role-arn "arn:aws:iam::736265540791:role/dbgap-etl" \ --role-session-name "s3-test" \ > assume-role-output.json \ || fail "Failed to assume target dbgap-etl role"
AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID="$(jq -r '.Credentials.AccessKeyId' assume-role-output.json)" AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SecretAccessKey' assume-role-output.json)" AWS_SESSION_TOKEN="$(jq -r '.Credentials.SessionToken' assume-role-output.json)"
export AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
[[ -n "${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}" && "${AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID}" != "null" ]] || fail "Missing target AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID" [[ -n "${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}" && "${AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY}" != "null" ]] || fail "Missing target AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY" [[ -n "${AWS_SESSION_TOKEN}" && "${AWS_SESSION_TOKEN}" != "null" ]] || fail "Missing target AWS_SESSION_TOKEN"
aws s3 cp ./stage/ "${target_s3_uri}" \ --exclude "*" \ --include "sstr*" \ --include "*summary.json" \ --recursive \ --no-progress \ || fail "Failed to copy staged files to ${target_s3_uri}"
unset AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
rm -rf ./stage done
